title:
A second shrill whistle, prolonged angrily, brought one of the girls to the foot of the staircase.
 
 —Yes, father?
 
 —Is your lazy bitch of a brother gone out yet?
html_source: Stephen’s father, Simon Dedalus, has become even more of an alcoholic than before, making the Dedalus household even more unattractive than before for Stephen, further compelling him to stay away, especially now that he is at university.
